content: Hi Dave, I would recommend that you make a new topic to introduce yourself. That way more people will see it. :)

@Dave Ingle indeed it is! Here is a new topic to introduce yourself
Look at me. My own topic. Mother I made it.
QQ. Can I use this topic to keep my particular brand of madness contained. Essentially I'm doing a bunch of work in AI governance and that causes me to do things that I don't know are... real.
Theories on Projection Timing Sensitivity, silent projection loss and debt aware computation.

This is a professional research forum, not Discord: we would prefer if people wrote one message at a time (not three) talking only about Lean-related stuff (and not light-hearted banter). Messages not about Lean are strictly off-topic and will be removed.

Authenticity maters to me. If I can't be myself somewhere, I won't go there. If there is a topic with my name on it, in a feed called 'new members'. It's going to include some light-hearted banter. That's non-negotiable. ADHD causes the sporadic messages.

I'm here for Lean-related reasons.

I'll come back when I have something more substantial.
